studies.expression: Shared source prefix; add .35*y^3; retain versus remove its program knowledge.
studies.scope: Learned local response versus frozen old and empirically identified unguarded new branch.
studies.units: Shared source prefix; anonymous roles and new units; retain versus remove programs.
studies.methods: Shared measured prefix; new roles and reversed instrument order; retain versus clear methods.
studies.observation_uncertainty: Same prefix with versus without auxiliary instruments; heteroscedastic calibration.
studies.simplification_return: Simpler response then old nonlinear return; shared versus fully expressive task-local research.

information_contract: Three finite algebraic analog families, not real-world domains. The researcher sees no stage/family labels or latent simulator values. Arms have equal per-task caps and the same expressive search. Branches inherit identical paid states; deletion changes only the indicated persisted knowledge. Main-arm execution order is randomized by seed. All independent terminal evaluations follow all research. Scope and dense-fit comparisons are prediction diagnostics on the same purchased data, not additional end-to-end agents. Failures remain in the cohort.
